blocks.text: Anne Curtis was one proud mom when her six-year-old daughter Dalhia impressed the audience during her first singing recital with a brave performance of “This is Me.” The actress-TV host and sometimes concert performer on Sunday uploaded a video clip of Dalhia, who was accompanied onstage by an ensemble of musicians as she performed the popular track from “The Greatest Showman” at the RMA concert. The clip also showed her and husband Erwan Heussaff looking amazed at their daughter’s feat.
